FREE: how to verify this agent's Agent Card was issued by getvda.ai.

The card at /.well-known/agent.json carries a detached JWS in its `proof`. The
signed bytes are the card with `proof` removed, serialised with sorted keys and no
whitespace — reproduce that exactly or the digest will differ.

FREE capability proof: runs the real executor on a canned input. Cached ~45s
(so it can't be abused as a free LLM endpoint) and never paywalled — this is how
the Portfolio Router verifies the agent and captures a real example output.

get.description: What this agent is, for an LLM that found it without a human in the loop.

A ready-to-import Power Apps custom connector for Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Copilot Studio's second onboarding path takes an OpenAPI file, so serving one turns
"follow five wizard steps" into "import this URL". `x-ms-agentic-protocol:
mcp-streamable-1.0` is what marks the operation as MCP streamable — the only
transport Copilot Studio still supports (SSE was dropped after August 2025).

No authentication is declared because none is required: discovery and `selftest` are
free, so a maker can import this and verify the agent before any payment exists.

Crawl policy for this agent.

Every agent is its own host (`<name>.getvda.ai`), so the portfolio's robots.txt
at agents.getvda.ai does not apply here — each one needs its own. Without it
crawlers get a 404: OAI-SearchBot was observed requesting this and finding
nothing, which is a bad first impression for the one file a crawler reads first.

Deliberately NOT added to FREE_PATHS: that set is what the 10 req/s limiter
polices, and a 429 on robots.txt tells Google the host is unavailable and makes
it back off crawling *everything* here. The body is a fixed string, so there is
nothing to protect.

`/mcp-metered/` is disallowed because it always answers 402 without payment —
letting crawlers spend budget discovering that helps nobody.
